purpose: Propose the first on-chain role assignment for the QPF Guardian Safe. Generate pre-execution governance receipt. No signing, no broadcast, no wallet action performed by repo.

proposed_action.title: Deploy Phase 7 yield-routing contracts with Safe as FeeCollector owner
proposed_action.description: Deploy YieldRouterFactory via forge script, then call deployAll() with the Safe address as _guardian. This makes the Safe the owner of FeeCollector, giving it authority to activate fee collection, manage guardians, and pause/unpause routing.

proposed_arguments._guardians: At minimum: [0x8d088B88219D072aB035502065ee2410c2cb4389]. Additional guardian addresses can be added.
proposed_arguments._predictedFeeCollector: Must be computed after YieldRouterFactory deployment via: cast compute-address --nonce 3 <FACTORY_ADDR>

operational_treasury_authority.guardians: proposeExpenditure(), approveExpenditure(), executeExpenditure(), pause(), unpause(), setThreshold()

next_human_gate.step: Review this proposal. If approved, the next actionable steps are:
actions: 1. Authorize deployment of YieldRouterFactory via forge script
2. Compute predicted FeeCollector address: cast compute-address --nonce 3 <FACTORY_ADDR>
4. Safe owners submit execTransaction to activate FeeCollector (activate())
5. Safe owners submit execTransaction to configure guardians/additional Safe threshold if desired

social_recovery_module.status: CREATED / NOT YET PRODUCTION-AUTHORIZED — not required for this phase
